information_policy: Training-period development only; these years and narrow angle were inspected previously, not independent confirmation. No adaptive tuning, 2019-2024 access, promotion or hardware.
noise_policy: Declared synthetic local model, not backend calibration. Four-qubit density matrix includes damping; ten-qubit selector uses unitary coherent errors plus readout. DD is ideal XpXm refocusing of explicit spectator idle drift per CX, not physical scheduled DD. Twirling is CX Pauli-frame conjugation; correct readout separately for each randomization before averaging.
postprocessing_policy: Preserve raw counts/quasi-probabilities. Kernel PSD/rank4 repair uses training eigenvectors for cross projection. Selection clips/normalizes corrected quasi-probabilities for one fixed auxiliary classical resample, then existing cardinality filter and actual addon SQD. No extra quantum shots to replace discarded draws.
source_preflight: Available dependencies, dataset hash and circuit resources checked before freezing; no noisy performance outcomes evaluated.
execution: Exclusive intent, local simulator only; partial failures preserved; no automated retries.
